Hi all — quick technical update before we lock the slot: during post-run validation we spotted a small discrepancy in the synthetic load generator that affected sustained p99 values for long-tail scenarios. I want to correct the artifact and re-run the long-tail pass to ensure the numbers we present are representative. That will take until EOD Apr 20 PT.

Proposed adjustment: move the readout to Wed Apr 21 10:30–11:15 PT so we can include the corrected p99 curves and a short appendix on mitigation (KV cache tuning + request sharding).

Proposed agenda (45 min):
- 5 min: Introductions and objective
- 10 min: Benchmark methodology recap
- 15 min: Results (p50/p95/p99, error rates, tail behavior)
- 10 min: Recommended config & next steps (pilot capacity, cost estimate)
- 5 min: Procurement and action items

I’ll attach the corrected runbook and a snippet of the updated p99 chart to the invite.

Thanks,
